Age of Sigmar / Painted warband

Stormcast
Eternals.

The might of the storm. The chill of a Death Knight.

My Stormcast Eternals warband, painted to resemble the Death Knights from World of Warcraft. Cold blues, deep violet and silver armour bring that inspiration to the Mortal Realms.

01 / The inspiration

A colder kind of
Stormcast.

The Death Knight influence lives in the colour palette: blue and violet armour, bright silver weapons, and icy blue details. Dark robes tie the three warriors together, while ruined stone bases give the group a shared setting.
